color.label: Overlay Color
color.hint: Ignored if using an overlay image.

partialColor.label: Partials Color
partialColor.hint: If empty, the overlay color will be used. If not empty and using an overlay image, the partials will be colored for the GM but not for the players.

partialOpacityPlayer.label: Partials Opacity
partialOpacityPlayer.hint: GMs will see a weighed opacity for the partially revealed spaces, calculated from the other opacities. This calculated value is shown on the right.

position.label: Overlay Position
position.hint: Whether it should display below tiles and textures or above.

Choices.behindDrawings: Cover the map and non-overhead tiles
Choices.behindTokens: Cover the map, non-overhead tiles, and drawings

tokenReveal.label: Token Reveal Distance
tokenReveal.hint: Distance (from center) to temporarily reveal around friendly tokens. Zero reveals the token's space only, and blank reveals nothing.

gridReveal.label: Extend Revealed Distance
gridReveal.hint: If set, revealed grid spaces extend a certain amount into hidden and partially revealed spaces. Does not extend the partially revealed spaces.

ResetDialog.Title: Reset Scene?
ResetDialog.Content: Are you sure you want to reset and update the entire scene?</br>This can't be undone!
